name: Midjourney
bestFor: The most artistic, beautiful AI images, for art, moodboards and concepts
about: Midjourney makes images from text descriptions. It is known for the most artistic, polished look of any AI image tool, which is why designers and artists use it for concepts and moodboards.
You use it on its website (or on Discord). It can also animate images into short videos.
useCases: Moodboards for a brand or project
features: Style and character references to keep a consistent look
Editor to change parts of an image

howToUse.title: Subscribe
howToUse.text: Sign in at midjourney.com and choose a plan. There is no free plan.

howToUse.title: Write a prompt
howToUse.text: Describe the subject, style, lighting and mood, for example "a cosy tea stall in old Lahore at dusk, warm light, watercolour".

howToUse.title: Pick and refine
howToUse.text: You get several options. Make variations of the one you like, or upscale it.

howToUse.title: Use references
howToUse.text: Add a style or character reference image to keep a consistent look across images.

howToUse.title: Download
howToUse.text: Download the full-size image from your gallery.

tips: Describe the style with art words: "watercolour", "35mm photo", "flat vector".
Use the aspect ratio setting for the shape you need, such as 16:9 for YouTube thumbnails.
Text inside images is better in Ideogram.
examplePrompt: a cosy roadside chai stall in old Lahore at dusk, warm string lights, steam rising from cups, watercolour illustration, soft colours
limitations: No free plan and no free trial.
On the cheaper plans, your images are public in the gallery.
freePlanDetails: No free plan and no free trial.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Leonardo.Ai
shortDescription: AI image and video generator with a daily free allowance.
bestFor: Making lots of AI images for free every day, with many styles
about: Leonardo.Ai is an image and video generator with many models and style presets. Its free plan gives you tokens every day, which makes it a good free choice for regular use.
It has tools for game art, product photos and consistent characters, and a canvas to edit and extend images.
features: Canvas editor to fix or extend images

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at leonardo.ai.

howToUse.title: Open Image Generation
howToUse.text: Choose a model or preset that matches the style you want.

howToUse.title: Write your prompt
howToUse.text: Describe the subject, style and setting, and choose the image size.

howToUse.title: Generate and edit
howToUse.text: Pick the best result, then use the canvas to fix details or upscale.

tips: Use the prompt enhance option if you are not sure how to describe a style.
Lower the number of images per generation to save tokens.
examplePrompt: flat illustration of a young woman working on a laptop in a small Karachi apartment, plants, morning light, clean pastel colours
limitations: Free images are public, and the best models cost more tokens.
Plan names and token prices change often.
pricingNote: US prices. Some sources still call the first paid plan "Apprentice".

name: Ideogram
shortDescription: AI image generator that is very good at text inside images.
bestFor: Posters, logos and social posts where the image needs readable text
about: Ideogram makes images from text, and it is the best known tool for putting clear, correctly spelled words inside an image. That makes it useful for posters, thumbnails, logos and greeting cards.
It also has a canvas for editing and extending images.
useCases: Social media posts with a quote
features: Style options such as design, realistic and 3D
Magic Prompt to improve your prompt
Canvas to edit and extend images

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create an account at ideogram.ai with Google or an email.

howToUse.title: Put the text in quotes
howToUse.text: Write the words you want inside the image in quotes, for example: a poster that says "Grand Opening".

howToUse.title: Choose a style and size
howToUse.text: Pick a style and an aspect ratio, such as 9:16 for stories.

howToUse.title: Generate and pick
howToUse.text: Choose the best result and download it, or remix it.

tips: Keep the text short. A few words work much better than a full sentence.
Turn Magic Prompt off if it changes your idea too much.
examplePrompt: a modern poster with the text "Eid Sale 50% Off" in bold gold letters, dark green background, crescent moon, clean design
limitations: Images made on the free plan are public.
Urdu text inside images is not reliable yet.
freePlanDetails: Limited slow generations each week. Images are public.
pricingNote: US prices. The older $8 Basic plan is no longer sold.

name: Adobe Firefly
shortDescription: Adobe's AI for images, video and design, built to be safe for commercial use.
bestFor: Commercial work where you need images that are safe to use for clients
about: Adobe Firefly is Adobe's family of AI tools for images, video and audio. Adobe trains its own models on content it has the rights to use, which is why many businesses choose it for client work.
It is also built into Photoshop (Generative Fill) and Adobe Express.
useCases: Images for ads and client projects
Removing or adding objects in photos
Extending a photo to a new size
features: Text to image and image to video
Generative Fill and Expand in Photoshop
Access to some partner models as well as Adobe's own

howToUse.title: Sign in
howToUse.text: Go to firefly.adobe.com and sign in with a free Adobe account.

howToUse.title: Choose a tool
howToUse.text: Pick Text to Image, Generative Fill or video.

howToUse.title: Describe what you want
howToUse.text: Write your prompt and choose content type (photo or art) and size.

howToUse.title: Refine
howToUse.text: Use style references and settings, then download or open in Photoshop or Express.

tips: Use Generative Fill to remove people or objects from a photo by brushing over them.
Check which model you used: Adobe's own models are the ones meant for commercial safety.
examplePrompt: product photo of a ceramic coffee mug on a wooden table by a window, soft morning light, shallow depth of field
limitations: Premium features such as video use credits, and the free amount is small.
Partner models may not have the same commercial-use protection as Adobe's own.
freePlanDetails: A small number of free credits with an Adobe account.
pricingNote: US prices. Prices differ by country.
